newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ZANETTI'S LATE STRIKE GIVES INTER ONE-POINT LEAD AT TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ZANETTI'S LATE STRIKE GIVES INTER ONE-POINT LEAD AT TOP.

text.p: A superb goal by Argentine Javier Zanetti five minutes from time gave Inter a 1-0 win at Verona on Sunday and a one-point lead at the top of Italy's serie A.

Inter's last-gasp win took full advantage of surprise home draws for title rivals Juventus, held 1-1 by Napoli, and Milan, who needed a second-half penalty from Demetrio Albertini to avoid defeat to lowly Atalanta at the San Siro.

Inter, who were taken to a penalty shoot-out before seeing off Austria's Graz in the UEFA Cup last week, lead the first division with 17 points from eight matches, one ahead of Vicenza and two clear of European champions Juventus.
Unfancied Vicenza, who have never won a major trophy in their 94-year history, claimed second spot with a 2-0 win against Lazio at the Olympic stadium -- the Rome club's third successive defeat.
Roberto Mancini, linked with a possible move to Inter, celebrated his 400th and perhaps last match for Sampdoria with two goals in a 3-0 home win over Piacenza.
The result lifted his side to equal third place with Milan and Bologna, 3-2 winners over Roma despite the dismissal of manager Renzo Ulivieri.
